name: 02_wash_pan
title: Washing and Stowing Frying Pan
summary: The robot washes a frying pan under running water, stows it into a dish crate, inspects the counter, and turns off the faucet.
robot: two robotic arms with multi-fingered dexterous hands
setting: a kitchen sink area with a running faucet, dish soap, sponge, and blue dish crate

source.original_prompt: Wash the held black frying pan under the faucet

segments.instruction: Rotate the pan under the running faucet with the left hand while the right hand reaches toward the sponge on the counter.
Scrub the interior of the frying pan with the sponge in the right hand while holding it under running water.
Place the sponge back on the rear ledge and set the rinsed frying pan down inside the blue dish crate.
segments.memory_event: hide: the frying pan is placed inside the blue crate among the dishes

segments.instruction: Turn the head camera to the left counter away from the sink and crate, focusing on the dish soap bottle.
segments.memory_event: hide: the sink, running faucet, and blue crate leave the field of view

segments.instruction: Use the left hand to push the dish soap bottle slightly back against the wall while keeping the camera on the left counter.
Turn the head camera back toward the center sink and the blue dish crate.
segments.memory_event: return: the sink with running water, sponge on the ledge, and the crate containing the rinsed pan reappear

segments.instruction: Reach up with the right hand and push the faucet handle to shut off the running water.
Reach into the blue dish crate with the left hand and pick up the pan placed there earlier.
segments.memory_event: return: the frying pan is lifted from the blue crate, appearing clean and wet
